_comment: A compiled artifact, which is what BlueScrub actually grades. The existing sample_repo_spec.json is source only, so until this landed nothing exercised the pipeline against its intended subject — and the calibration measurements that shaped the severity ladder were all taken against source trees. Inert by construction: strings and structure, no behaviour. Compiled stripped (-s) so it resembles something that would ship.

planted.codename: NIGHTFALL, in both the build path and the mutex name
planted.org: redcell, in the hostname, the operator address and the build path
planted.toolchain: the GCC version string the compiler embeds
